text.content:
Sect: Independent (no formal sect allegiance)

Caitiff are vampires born without a clan, either due to a botched Embrace, an unknown sire, or a parentage too diluted or disgraced to claim any of the thirteen clans. They are looked down upon by clanned Kindred and typically occupy the lowest rungs of vampire society, regardless of their personal talents.

Disciplines: Caitiff have no clan Disciplines of their own; they may begin play with an eclectic mix of Disciplines drawn from different clans, though typically only at a basic level.

Disadvantage: Caitiff suffer social stigma throughout Kindred society and are typically of higher generation, limiting their potential power and standing among other vampires.

Organization: Without clan or formal sect backing, Caitiff must rely on personal alliances, mentors, or sheer self-sufficiency to survive in Kindred society.

Advantage: The clanless Caitiff have no fixed clan Disciplines: they may develop any three Disciplines as their own.

Disadvantage: With no clan, a Caitiff has no clan weakness — but also no clan Disciplines by right, no elders or mentors, and little standing in Kindred society.
